paper_title: Discovering QCD-Coupled Axion Dark Matter with Polarization Haloscopes
coupling_convention: 1/f_a in GeV^-1 (axion-gluon/EDM coupling), NOT converted to d_n in e*cm
notes: Projection (SNR>=2) paper proposing a 'polarization haloscope' to probe the QCD axion-gluon coupling via axion-induced oscillating atomic EDMs. Fig. 2 y-axis is 1/f_a in GeV^-1 vs axion mass m_a in eV (range ~1e-7 to 1e-4 eV, i.e. ~0.1-10 GHz). Three benchmark curves: 100 L prototype (thermal fp), hyperpolarized cubic meter, and post-discovery upgrade. The plotted coupling is 1/f_a (gluon coupling), physically equivalent to the CP-odd EDM coupling but NOT the raw neutron EDM d_n in e*cm — I emitted 1/f_a values in GeV^-1 without conversion. Data points are ROUGH visual estimates of the cubic-meter scanning reach envelope; exact numbers cannot be read reliably from the figure, hence low extraction confidence. QCD axion line follows 1/f_a = m_a[eV]/5.7e6 GeV^-1.
